ai-repository-audit.title: AI repository audit
ai-repository-audit.summary: Compare a repository with its accepted baseline and report evidence-backed drift.
ai-repository-audit.review_note: Retains the October 21 skill from 8e31ef1. Baseline, evidence and read-only boundaries reviewed. No new model benchmark or certification of a target repository is claimed.
ai-repository-audit.requirements: Access to the scoped repository, Git history and its accepted baseline. Run only project checks already available and authorized.

archive-readiness.title: Task archive readiness
archive-readiness.summary: Check whether requested work is complete and identify unfinished items before archiving a chat.
archive-readiness.review_note: Imported from the maintainer local skill. Read-only current-task scope reviewed. No new model benchmark or product-specific integration test claimed.
archive-readiness.requirements: Current task context and read-only tools for the systems already in scope. No mandatory external service.

laravel-sdd-bootstrap.title: Laravel recording starter
laravel-sdd-bootstrap.summary: Prepare standalone PHP/Composer, Blade and SQLite, leaving the teaching feature for the recording.
laravel-sdd-bootstrap.review_note: Derived from an actual native Windows Laravel recording setup using PHP 8.5.5, Composer 2.9.5 and Laravel 13.38.0. Starter tests, formatting, migrations and HTTP/assets were checked. The lesson feature was intentionally unbuilt. Other hosts and model comparisons are not benchmarked.
laravel-sdd-bootstrap.requirements: PHP and Composer compatible with the selected Laravel release. Browser and editor are optional. No Herd, Node, Docker or MCP requirement for a plain Blade/public-CSS starter.

project-kickoff.title: Project kickoff
project-kickoff.summary: Create a portable brief, plan, backlog, decisions and agent guidance without overwriting a project.
project-kickoff.review_note: Imported from the maintainer local skill updated October 23. Templates and create-only helper reviewed; helper behavior tests are included in CI. Model trigger and output comparisons have not been run.
project-kickoff.requirements: Filesystem access; Python 3.11+ only when using the bundled scaffold helper. No network or service account required.

sdd-stage-planner.title: Plan the next build stage
sdd-stage-planner.summary: Refine the next feature and its file plan before implementation, with a readable planning companion.
sdd-stage-planner.review_note: Imported from the maintainer local skill. Private/example-specific wording removed; instruction and resource review completed. No fresh cross-model or client-rendering benchmark claimed.
sdd-stage-planner.requirements: An existing project with source and planning context. Browser inspection is useful for a visual planner; no required MCP service.
